prompt: Create an original, matching-series character sprite sheet for a pink rabbit host in the children's educational video Num-Num Numbers. Same rabbit, color, proportions, head design and scale in all four poses. Four full-body, straight-on isolated poses, arranged as a perfectly spaced 2 by 2 sprite sheet on a genuinely transparent background, one whole rabbit within each quadrant, ample clear margins and no overlap.
